# Product Advisory

> Product Advisory, LLC is a product management consulting firm in Chicago, Illinois that helps startups and enterprises build market driven products: turning market insight into roadmaps teams can defend, and products people actually want. Founded by Robert Merrell (Fractional CPO). Over 50 years of combined technology and product experience across healthcare, data strategy and enterprise software.

## Services
- [Product Strategy Development](https://www.productadvisory.co/services#strategy): for when your roadmap doesn't connect to business goals.
- [Product Lifecycle Management](https://www.productadvisory.co/services#lifecycle): for when strategy and execution operate in silos.
- [AI Enablement](https://www.productadvisory.co/services#ai): for when AI adoption is scattered across a few individuals instead of built into how your team actually works.
- [Market Research and Analysis](https://www.productadvisory.co/services#research): for when decisions are based on guesses, not evidence.
- [Agile Transformation](https://www.productadvisory.co/services#agile): for when speed doesn't translate into building the right things.
- [Product Team Coaching and Development](https://www.productadvisory.co/services#coaching): for teams with the will, but not yet the process.
- [Custom Assessments & Interactive Learning](https://www.productadvisory.co/services#assessments): for when you don't actually know where your team's skill gaps are, or your training doesn't target them.
- [Service packages](https://www.productadvisory.co/services#packages): Fractional CPO+, Training & Education, Market Validation, Go to Market, Security & Compliance, Contracting & Legal, Sales & Marketing, UX/UI Design.

## Free resources
- [Toolkits](https://www.productadvisory.co/toolkits): fillable PDF and Google Sheet decision tools (Build, Buy, or Partner Decision Matrix; Organizational Impact Score).
- [Feature Prioritization Scorecard](https://www.productadvisory.co/scorecard): a free interactive tool that ranks features with weighted scoring or RICE and compares the two rankings side by side.
- [AI Use Case Prioritization](https://www.productadvisory.co/ai-use-cases): a free interactive tool that scores AI ideas on value, data readiness, cost, team readiness and risk, maps them by value and feasibility, and names the first pilot to run.
- [Which prioritization method? cheat sheet](https://www.productadvisory.co/assets/toolkits/which-prioritization-method.pdf): a one-page PDF on when to use RICE, weighted scoring or ICE.
- Coming soon: Product Strategy One Pager. [Vote or request a tool](https://assessment.productadvisory.co/tool-requests)
- [PM + AI skill assessment](https://assessment.productadvisory.co/): 14 questions across seven product and AI competencies, with a personalized learning path.

- [The Feature Fallacy](https://www.productadvisory.co/insights/feature-fallacy): Why shipping more isn't helping your users, and what to do instead.

## Questions people ask
- **What does a product management consultant do?** We help a company decide what to build and why, then make sure it gets built and launched well. That can mean an evidence-based product strategy, a roadmap tied to business goals, market and customer research, a repeatable lifecycle process, or coaching your product managers. We work alongside your team rather than replacing it.
- **What is a Fractional CPO, and when do we need one?** A Fractional Chief Product Officer is senior product leadership for part of the week instead of a full-time executive hire. It fits when you have no clear product strategy or owner, your roadmap and growth goals live in separate documents, or your product team needs a leader to mentor them. Our Fractional CPO+ package sets product vision, builds your roadmap process and mentors your team, scaled to your stage and budget.
- **How do you help a company adopt AI?** We turn scattered individual AI use into an organizational capability in three steps: choose the right first use case, run a real pilot with your team, then put in the governance and habits that make adoption stick company-wide. Our free AI Use Case Prioritization tool (productadvisory.co/ai-use-cases) helps with the first step.
- **Do you work with startups or enterprises?** Both. Our service packages are scoped for early-stage startups and for enterprises, and we scale our involvement from a single focused project to an embedded, end-to-end product partnership.
- **Where are you based? Do you work remotely?** Product Advisory is based in Chicago, Illinois, and works with teams around the world, remotely and on site.
- **How do we get started?** Book a free 30-minute call. We will talk through what you are working on and where we could help. If you are not sure which service fits, the three-question finder on the Services page suggests a starting point.
- **Can we see how your assessments work before we commit?** Yes. Our PM + AI skill assessment is live: 14 questions across seven product and AI skill areas, with a personalized learning path at the end. It is free to take at assessment.productadvisory.co.
